newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Trelleborg buys Park Rubber's operations.
newsitem.headline: Trelleborg buys Park Rubber's operations.

text.p: Trelleborg Industri, a unit of Swedish metals and mining group Trelleborg AB, said on Monday it bought the operations of Britain's Park Rubber.
It bought the operations from Frederick Cooper plc, the company said in a release without disclosing the purchase amount.
Park Rubber makes extruding rubber profiles for sealing windows and doors and has an annual turnover of 100 million crowns and 180 employees. About 25 percent of its sales are exported.

"The acquisition is part of our ambition to become the leading supplier of extruding profiles to the European construction industry with door and window manufacturers as a focus," said Trelleborg's chief executive, Kjell Nilsson.
"Our estimate is that demand for qualified products for more efficient sealing of windows and doors will increase sharply in the next few years, mainly in eastern Europe."
Park Rubber's name will be changed to Trelleborg Park.
